{"text": "import opentrons
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "PCR setup 8 samples", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 3)

    # Pipettes
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack])

    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="PCR master mix",
        display_color="#FF0000"
    )
    samples = {}
    for i in range(1, 9):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample {i}",
            description=f"DNA sample {i}",
            display_color="#00FF00"
        )
        samples[f"sample {i}"] = liq

    # Load liquids into sources
    tuberack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1500)  # master mix tube
    # Place samples in tubes B1, C1, D1, A2, B2, C2, D2, A3
    sample_positions = ["B1", "C1", "D1", "A2", "B2", "C2", "D2", "A3"]
    for i, pos in enumerate(sample_positions, start=1):
        tuberack[pos].load_liquid(liquid=samples[f"sample {i}"], volume=500)

    # Distribute master mix 20 ul to column 1 (A1-H1) using single channel, one tip
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    # Aspirate exactly 20 ul * 8 wells
    p300.aspirate(20 * 8, tuberack["A1"])
    for letter in ["A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H"]:
        well = f"{letter}1"
        p300.dispense(20, plate[well])
    p300.drop_tip()

    # Add samples 5 ul each using single channel, new tip per sample
    sample_locations = ["B1","C1","D1","A2","B2","C2","D2","A3"]
    dest_wells = ["A1","B1","C1","D1","E1","F1","G1","H1"]
    for src, dst in zip(sample_locations, dest_wells):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, tuberack[src])
        p20.dispense(5, plate[dst])
        p20.drop_tip()
"}

protocol.py: 2 biology problems (2 notes).

1. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No no-template control: 8 wells of master mix with a sample
   line 44:  p300.dispense(20, plate[well])
   At line 44 the robot starts putting master mix into NEST 96 Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full
   Skirt (slot 3), and 8 wells end holding it together with a sample. No well on this plate
   holds the mix without a sample, so there is no no-template control. If a reagent is
   contaminated, or the primers pair with each other, every well gives a signal and nothing
   on the plate can tell that from a real one. Wells: wells A1, B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and
   H1 in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A1, B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 3.
   Fix: Add one well (three for qPCR) with 20 ul of master mix and 5 ul of water in place of
   the template, and tell the plate map where it is.
   Source: MIQE 2009: a no-template control on every plate is essential
           https://gene-quantification.com/miqe-bustin-et-al-clin-chem-2009.pdf
   Source: MIQE 2.0 (2025): the no-template and no-RT controls, still essential
           https://academic.oup.com/clinchem/article/71/6/634/8119148
   Source: Bustin 2025: MIQE compliance remains patchy
           https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC12154065/fullTextXML
   Source: Qiagen bench guide: PCR controls (no-template, no-RT, positive)
           https://www.qiagen.com/en-us/knowledge-and-support/knowledge-hub/bench-guide/pcr/reference-genes-and-controls/pcr-controls
   Source: Bio-Rad real-time PCR applications guide: controls in triplicate
           https://www.bio-rad.com/webroot/web/pdf/lsr/literature/Bulletin_5279.pdf
   Source: Thermo Maxima SYBR manual: the NTC contains all components except template DNA
           https://assets.fishersci.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0012933_Maxima_SYBR_Green_qPCR_Master_ROX_Sol__k0251_UG.pdf
   [83f4ded2135b]

2. NOTE UNMIXED-AT-END: 8 wells never mixed after sample 1, sample 2, sample 3, sample 4 and
4 more went in (20% of the well)
   line 53:  p20.dispense(5, plate[dst])
   At line 53 the robot added sample 1, sample 2, sample 3, sample 4 and 4 more to wells A1,
   B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1 and H1 in slot 3, which already held master mix (this line did it
   8 times). The addition was 20% of the well, nothing mixed the well afterwards, and the
   run ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their

   usually vortexed and spun down before cycling; if this one will not be, mix it.
